mapper.select: SELECT FROM concepts WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id, name, category, status FROM concepts ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concepts (name, category, difficulty, summary, body, status, source) VALUES (#{name}, #{category}, #{difficulty}, #{summary}, #{body}, 'DRAFT', 'AI') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id) SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM concepts WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id
SELECT c.id, c.category FROM concept_wishes w JOIN concepts c ON c.id = w.concept_id AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT a.id AS analysis_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.title), ''), a.project_name) AS analysis_title, f.id AS file_id, f.path AS file_path, ac.line_hint, ac.context_note FROM analysis_concepts ac JOIN analyses a ON a.id = ac.analysis_id LEFT JOIN analysis_files f ON f.id = ac.file_id WHERE ac.concept_id = #{conceptId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'DONE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.category, c.difficulty, c.summary, c.wish_count, c.avg_rating FROM analysis_concepts me JOIN analyses a ON a.id = me.analysis_id AND a.status = 'DONE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN analysis_concepts other ON other.analysis_id = me.analysis_id AND other.concept_id <> me.concept_id JOIN concepts c ON c.id = other.concept_id AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE me.concept_id = #{conceptId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.category, c.difficulty, c.summary, c.wish_count, c.avg_rating ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT me.analysis_id) DESC, c.wish_count DESC, c.avg_rating DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
